content: Ndaa yi yà ndandaa: kya mbuur usàkal anà ngyal a isal a ikyɛɛŋ a Ikööŋ, nde kan'sɔɔl isal a ntsà.
Un'kyɛɛŋ a Ikööŋ akal mbuur akɔ̈ɔ̈n ifà ibe, un'dim a un'kyay mwɛy mpɛl, mbuur mpa awà ngaal, mbuur a duu, ŋambwäär aŋàbwaŋ, ŋun'kaay, mbuur kan'kwo mulɔŋ,
mpa awà un'yöör a man anà un'nwään a ngwiy, wɛɛ nde akal mbuur a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà ŋun'tüüb, mbuur mpa afàkwen ngim mbɔɔn.
Wɛy nde ukäl aŋàkwo muyaal ndwà ande ŋàkwo anà mukyer naa baan ande bàkäl unsà unkyeey anà làzir lanswà.
Lalan, kya mbuur uyöb anki muler ndwà ande ŋàkwo, nde ayàkwo aben muler Ikööŋ a Nzam?
Nde ukwo anki mukal mbuur akün unsà mbuul a mpem, naa tɛy, nde ayàsɛɛn an'pɛy, waa uyàwal mbar asànaa kàwɛl ileŋ.
Wɛy sye naa baar abà u nsà a Ikööŋ bun'tɛɛl imbäl aŋàbwaŋ, ntɔn nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u nswɛn anà unsà intaam a ileŋ.
Ifà imwɛy sye, asyääl bàkal baar a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n anà bà mpem mwɛy. Ba bàkal anki ayɔ̈ɔ̈r a man anà baar bàfàkal anà ilään a bweel a nswɛn.
Wɛy ba bàkäär ngyee a làkwikilà unsà an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ.
Yubwaŋ naa bàtwab atàsi, ungö, isàkal naa undiir un'be bàmɛn anki amu ba, apan waa ba bàsal.
Akaar sye bàkal baar a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, mpa bàfàtwee, baar a duu, bàfasyeel mpem unsà indiir byanswà.
Asyääl a Ikööŋ abaal bàkal adim a un'kyay mwɛy mpɛl anà bàkyer ayöb muyaal baan aba anà ndwà aba ŋakwo.
Ntɔn asyääl bàfàkyer isal aba ubwaŋàbwaŋ bàfàwal làkoo anà uyɔl byan'fà unsà làkwikilà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Amasöön mɛ indiir abi, ntɔn mɛ an'sà làkyän naa mɛ in'kyer ayàlaler ungö a kitaaŋ.
Itàkal abun, kya mɛ in'sàlam muyà, ngye akyer ayàyɔ̈b naa nkääl angye ikal aben u ndwà a Nzam, ayà Ikɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈, ta a ndwà anà un'käär a ndandaa.
Ukɔɔn mbaaŋ, Ngyee unsà inzaam yà kölàköl! Klistɔ:

content.text: nde kàyàmɛnà akà akyeey a Nzam.
